Cricket Selection Debate: Kaif Criticizes India's Squad for New Zealand T20I

Former cricketer Mohammad Kaif has criticized the Indian team's selection for the T20 International series against New Zealand. Kaif specifically questioned the axing of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and the recall of Ishan Kishan. The discussion also involves the potential dropping of Sanju Samson ahead of the final T20I, with Sooryavanshi's potential return being considered.
